channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Members of popular girl band get suspended 3-month prison sentences
item.description: An Istanbul court on Dec. 15 sentenced each of the six members of the popular Turkish girl band Manifest to three months and 22 days in prison on charges of “obscene acts” and “public indecency,” but deferred the announcement of the verdict.

item.title: DEM Party to expand peace bid talks with AKP, Justice Ministry
item.description: A delegation from the Peoples' Equality and Democracy Party (DEM Party) that has been in contact with jailed PKK leader Abdullah Öcalan as part of Türkiye’s latest peace initiative is set to continue its political outreach with meetings with the ruling Justice and Development Party (AKP) and the Justice Ministry.

item.title: Manisa district bids farwell to mayor after cancer battle
item.description: The Şehzadeler district of the western province of Manisa came together on Dec. 15 to bid farewell to Mayor Gülşah Durbay, who passed away while receiving treatment for colon cancer.

item.title: Stable Syria an asset for the region: Fidan
item.description: A stable Syria free from foreign interventions will be a very important asset for the region, the Turkish top diplomat has said, reiterating Türkiye’s continued support to the Syrian people to this end.

item.title: Türkiye seeks global boost for geographically indicated products
item.description: Türkiye aims to enhance the international recognition and economic value of its geographically indicated products, ranking second globally in such registrations, according to the Turkish Patent and Trademark Office (TURKPATENT).

item.title: Turkish mining sector proposes critical minerals authority to unlock rare earth potential
item.description: A new proposal calls for establishing a critical minerals authority in Türkiye to evaluate the country's potential in rare earth elements (REEs), according to Turkish Union of Chambers and Commodity Exchanges (TOBB) Mining Council Chair İbrahim Halil Kırşan.

item.title: EU set to scrap 2035 combustion-engine ban in car industry boost
item.description: The EU looks set to scrap a landmark 2035 ban on new petrol and diesel cars on Tuesday, as part of a package of reforms aimed at supporting Europe's embattled auto industry.

item.title: Out-of-control drone shot down coming from Black Sea: Ministry
item.description: Türkiye on Dec. 15 shot down a drone that "lost control" and approached its airspace from the Black Sea, its defence ministry said, following a series of security incidents linked to the Russia-Ukraine conflict.

item.title: Trump upbeat on Ukraine deal as US offers 'NATO-like' security
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump insisted Monday that a deal to end the Ukraine war was closer than ever, after Washington said it offered Kiev NATO-like security guarantees and voiced confidence Moscow would accept.

item.title: Regional conflicts trample UN human rights declaration: Erdoğan
item.description: The U.N.'s Universal Declaration of Human Rights is being violated in ongoing regional conflicts, President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said on Monday, marking its 77th anniversary.
